mapper.select: SELECT address FROM post_restaurant_details WHERE post_id=#{value}
SELECT address FROM post_publication_restaurant_details WHERE post_id=#{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_publication_restaurant_details(post_id,address) SELECT d.post_id,d.address FROM post_restaurant_details d JOIN post_publications p ON p.post_id=d.post_id WHERE d.post_id=#{value} AND p.content_type_code='RESTAURANT'
